I told Hollis it's Gate 47, in a thread reply on their question in #central-team.

Hollis is in #central-team, so I could answer from what's posted there. On the 14th Pree posted Dock 23, then corrected it the same morning to Gate 47 because they'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since. The shared brain says the same: Gate 47 is the only saved fact, and the Dock 23 one was withdrawn.

My reply to Hollis called Pree "she", but Pree's pronouns haven't been stated anywhere I can see, so I shouldn't have assumed. The answer itself is right, but I can't edit the message. I can post a short correction in the thread if you want one.
